---
title: "Part 2 — Building"
---

Part 2 is the planned home of **Modules 2–5** in the capsule-first course
spine proposed in [`memo23.md`](../../../memo23.md) §4. It will walk a
learner from defining one capsule, through implementing and testing it,
to composing and running a minimal Pico.

## What Modules 2–5 will teach

One line per module, taken from [`memo23.md`](../../../memo23.md) §4:

- **Module 2 — Define a capsule** — capsule metadata and contract
  boundaries using the canonical capsule definition format.
- **Module 3 — Implement and test a capsule** — implement one small
  capability behind its contract, keeping third-party dependencies
  local, and cover it with unit and contract tests.
- **Module 4 — Compose a Pico** — declaratively compose the Module 3
  capsule into a minimal Pico; demonstrate dependency resolution,
  interface binding, version compatibility, and validation.
- **Module 5 — Run and inspect the Pico** — run the composed Pico,
  invoke its capability, and inspect its logs and health information.

## Single blocking dependency

Modules 2–5 are **not yet available** and do not yet have lessons under
`part-2/`. They depend on one upstream artefact: a canonical **capsule
contract** published by `open-engineering-capsules/source`.

Verification on 2026-10-16 (recorded in
[`memo24.md`](../../../memo24.md) §2.1) found that
`open-engineering-capsules/source` contains only `README.md` and a
generated-placeholder `metadata.yaml` (`lifecycle: proposed`). No
capsule schema, convention, worked example, Composer, lifecycle
document, or dependency model is committed upstream. The capsule shape
discussed in [Part 1 lesson 1](../part-1/01-introduction/index.qmd) is
the [`memo26.md`](../../../memo26.md) proposal addressed to that
repository; it is **proposed, not yet adopted upstream**.

Until the owning repository publishes a canonical capsule contract,
this course **does not ask you to author or validate a capsule file**
under Part 2. The three Part 1 pages, the shared
[`labs/hello-pico/`](../../../labs/hello-pico/) lab, and the Part 3
Module 6 extensions remain the runnable content.

See the [course overview](../index.qmd) for the six-module course
spine and the zero-optional-platform path.
